{{Dialogue|Jax Pavan|I’ve been meaning to finish the one I started to build myself, but…|Laranth Tarak|What’s stopped you?|Jax Pavan|I didn’t have a power source that would resonate with the Ilum crystal to generate a coherent field.|Kajin Savaros|Isn’t that one?|Jax Pavan|You’re right. Several months after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] sought to create a new '''lightsaber'''<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> following the destruction of his previous [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|one]] in the [[Factory District]].<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> He asked [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] to try and find components and materials, though he came up bare. [[Den Dhur]] then suggested he should try and find some. He visited [[Ploughtekal Market]] and got all the necessary parts to make a functioning [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], if not stylish. The only part Dhur failed to find was a [[compressed energy crystal]]. Jax Pavan constructed the hilt but without the CEC the lightsaber was useless. He was later handed [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing’s]] [[Color/Legends|crimson]] [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]] by [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] in an anonymous package, to which Jax favored using Sing’s old hilt.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />

Some months later, after Jax and [[Laranth Tarak]] met and helped a teenage [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] called [[Kajin Savaros]] back to [[Poloda Place|Jax’s conapt]], Jax offered to train Kaj. [[I-5YQ]] suggested that if they could find a new crystal that could hand the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystalless]] hilt to Savaros and Jax could retrofit his current lightsaber with that crystal.<ref name="CNIII:POF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>

While tinkering with [[Ves Volette|Ves Volette’s]] [[Light sculpture|light sculptures]] Jax admitted he was meaning to finish the hilt, when Laranth asked why he didn’t make any more progress on the hilt Jax wondered why he hadn't finished it before answering that he didn’t have a power source that would resonate with the [[Ilum crystal/Legends|Ilum crystal]] to create a coherent field. Kajin asked that didn’t the light sculptures have a power module, since they used lightsaber technology. Jax realized that they did and recognized there were extra components for the light sculptures lying around, waiting. Jax made note that he’d have to ask [[Dejah Duare]] if he could use some of the late Ves Volette’s parts to finish his lightsaber.<ref name="CNIII:POF" />

Several months later Jax had been able to finish the lightsaber with Laranth before leaving Coruscant to bring [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] as he had been given a crystal to power it from an unexpected source. The crystal created a blue-green blade. He’d run through the forms of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] with it and found the weight of the hilt a comfort at his hip, just as comforting as stowing away the Sith blade from Aurra Sing, though he would still keep it on his person. Jax gave blue-green lightsaber to I-Five during a brief visit to [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] and then later used it in a brief confrontation with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] had [[Ambush near the Twins|trapped]] Jax and his team at the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]]. Laranth died in the ambush, Thi Xon Yimmon was captured, and I-Five was heavily damaged. Den, I-Five and Jax were able to escape before their ship, [[Far Ranger]], plunged into the twin stars, but not before Jax fetched his [[Miisai|miisai tree]]. The only things he had on him when he left the Far Ranger was his lightsaber, Aurra's lightsaber, the miisai tree, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|Holocron]] [[SD41263.I]] and Laranth's only in tact [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Jax later presented the lightsaber to [[Magash Drashi]] and [[Duala Aidu]] to prove he was a Jedi. Duala was skeptical as to whether Jax was a Jedi, while Magash was fascinated. Then Duala ordered Jax to hand her the lightsaber, which Jax obeyed.<ref name="TLJ" />

Pavan later used the lightsaber when confronting [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] about why he called off his infiltration on [[Kantaros Station]] so Jax could rescue Yimmon. Though Jax never attacked anyone with the blade, he did activate it.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lightsaber first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''. In that book, the lightsaber is stated to have all the necessary parts to make it work, except a compressed energy crystal.<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'' reiterates this, yet later on heavily implies that it has an Ilum crystal and clearly states it has no power module despite no progress having been made on the hilt since Street of Shadows at that point meaning there should be no crystal.''<ref name="CNIII:POF" />''

In the [[The Last Jedi (novel)|Last Jedi]] it is said that Jax and Laranth had constructed the hilt,<ref name="TLJ" /> but in Street of Shadows Jax is the only one shown to build the hilt while Laranth tinkers with her blasters.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
